summary: Boreo Oyj owns, acquires, and develops small and medium-sized companies in Finland, Sweden, the Baltic countries, and internationally. It operates through Electronics and Technical Trade segments. The company engages in the distribution, manufacturing, and assembly of electronic components and its own products; and provision of warehouse and logistics, technical sales, technical trade, and industrial services. It is also involved in the provision of electronics and engineering solutions; importing and wholesaling of AV accessories, equipment cases, and electromechanical components; design and manufacture of harnessing and electrical solutions for demanding applications; importing of thermal cameras; and development, production, and marketing of hand-held skin and edema measurement instruments. In addition, the company engages in the distribution of industrial and maintenance products; wholesale of power and construction equipment; after sales services, including repair, maintenance, and spare parts; sale and maintenance of machine tools; import of Fronius welding machines and equipment; turnkey solutions; and distribution of process filtration products and system, concrete pumps, and welding and cutting products, as well as Putzmeister's pumps. Further, it provides constructors of timber body superstructures; professional paintwork and blasting treatment; and scheduled delivery and trunk transport services. The company markets its products under Yleiselektroniikka, YE International, Noretron Komponentit, Milcon, Infradex, Signal Solutions Nordic, Delfin Technologies, YE RS, Machinery, Machinery MT, Pronius, J-Matic, Filterit, PM Nordic, HM Nordic, Tornokone, Floby Nya Bilverkstad, Lackmästarn, Etelä-Suomen Kuriiripalvelu Oy, Vesterbacka, Muottikolmio, and Spetselektroodi brands. The company was formerly known as Yleiselektroniikka Oyj and changed its name to Boreo Oyj in February 2021. Boreo Oyj was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Vantaa, Finland.
